it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 05/04/2026, na Câmara Municipal, depois que JHC (João Henrique Caldas) renunciou ao cargo, em 04/04/2026, para disputar a eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on April 5, 2026, at the City Council (the city's legislature), after Mayor JHC (João Henrique Caldas) resigned on April 4, 2026, to run in the 2026 election.
